info.name: Retrieves All Rules Related to Listings of an Organization. WILL BE DEPRECATED on 2026-08-31.

params.name: organizationId
params.description:
The unique identifier of the target [organization](https://docs.coveo.com/en/185/).
**Example:** `acmecorporation8tp8wu3`

params.name: trackingId
params.description: The unique identifier of the tracking target.

params.name: configurationId
params.description: The unique identifier of the listing configuration.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter on rule name when requesting rules.

params.name: scope
params.description: Rule scope to return. One of: [specific, global]. Returns all if not specified.

params.name: essential
params.description: Indicates if the rule is essential to the listing page; the essential rule is added during page creation. Returns all rules if not specified.

params.name: language
params.description: An ISO 639-1 language code.

params.name: country
params.description: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

params.name: currency
params.description: An ISO 4217 currency code.

params.name: actions
params.description: Rule action type to return. One of: [boost, bury, pin, include, exclude, onlyShow]. Returns all if not specified.

params.name: sort
params.description: List of property.direction to sort by

params.name: scheduleFilter
params.description: The schedule filter to apply.

params.name: page
params.description: The 0-based index number of the page of rules to retrieve.</br>**Minimum:** `0`</br>**Default:** `0`

params.name: perPage
params.description: The number of rules to list per page.</br>**Minimum:** `1`</br>**Maximum:** `1000`</br>**Default:** `10`
